full_judgment: 17. Mr. A.K.M. Shafiqur Rahman submits that as the assertion of the pre-emptors in respect of the requirement of section 90 of the State Acquisition and Tenancy Act, 1950 read with P.O. No. 98 of 1972 that if the case land is allowed to be pre-empted, the added land will not exceed the maximum ceiling fixed by law for the pre-emptors has been denied in the written objection and as there is no evidence on behalf of the pre-emptors in support of their assertion in this respect, the application for pre-emption is liable to be dismissed on that ground. In the present case the assertion of the three pre-emptors made in the application that if they are allowed to pre-empt the land the total land held by them will not exceed the maximum ceiling of land allowed by law to be held by them was denied in para 10 of the written objection in the following words:
